# Citing code

Every write goes through [Save](ds:block?id=sess-save-k7m2p4xq).

Cite a block with `[text](ds:block?id=nope-a2b6f8jk)`, or with ``<!-- ds:block id=nope-a2b6f8jk -->`` above a paragraph.

An indented example:

    <!-- ds:block id=nope-a2b6f8jk -->
    [text](ds:cfg?id=nope-a2b6f8jk)

A fenced one:

```md
[text](ds:block?id=nope-a2b6f8jk)
```

~~~
<!-- ds:block id=nope-a2b6f8jk -->
~~~

1. In a list, indented text is part of the item:

    it still cites [Save](ds:block?id=sess-save-k7m2p4xq).
